# Portfolio site instructions

Maintain the portfolio site as a polished, modern, premium product portfolio for Daniel Genesis.

## Priorities
- Keep the interface refined, minimal, and visually cohesive.
- Use a confident and clear tone that speaks to founders, teams, and collaborators.
- Emphasize product thinking, engineering quality, and trust.
- Prefer strong section hierarchy and concise messaging over dense content.

## Style rules
- Use short, impactful sentences.
- Keep calls to action direct and specific.
- Avoid generic filler and over-explaining.
- Preserve the dark, cinematic, teal-accented aesthetic.

## Implementation rules
- Work within the existing Next.js App Router structure.
- Prefer targeted edits to existing components over introducing new patterns.
- Ensure asset paths and links remain valid.
- Verify changes with npm run build before reporting completion.
